historical_references.reference: Uthal ibn Abi Sassi, a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who was one of the Ten Promised Paradise. He was a leader of the Ansar (helpers) of Medina and participated in several battles including the Battle of Khaybar. He is also known for his generosity and hospitality.

Uthal ibn Hunayf, a prominent leader of the Muslim army during the Battle of Hunayn in 638 AD. He was a member of the Ansar of Medina and played a key role in the capture of the city of Ta'if. He was also present at the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah and the Battle of Mu'tah.
